fixtures.title: a physically valid exploration proposal is reached, and is strictly stronger than eligibility
fixtures.note: The complete §6 contract is asserted field by field, so a row cannot be called valid on eligibility alone.

fixtures.title: a band with no reason to look is classified NO_MOTIVE and does not launch
a band with motive but no band-known heading yields NO HEADING from the real heading authority
fixtures.note: Constructed, not natural: the eleven worlds never reach this class, so the class is exercised on a controlled band-known state that only REMOVES knowledge. NO_HEADING is therefore architecturally reachable and the diagnostic class is not dead.

fixtures.title: two live proposals exist on the same decision and the chosen family PHYSICALLY LAUNCHED
fixtures.note: The second number is the point: a contest is only a contest when the winner goes.

fixtures.title: displacement is recorded only when another family actually launched
earlier family claims -> fails to launch -> slot free -> valid exploration exists -> production does NOT reconsider
fixtures.note: Every clause is asserted on every row, so this is fallthrough rather than ordering.

fixtures.title: a band that genuinely cannot raise two departable walkers is classified on labour
fixtures.note: The eleven natural worlds never fall below two departable walkers, so this is measured on a deliberately tiny band. The natural count is reported beside it rather than instead of it.

fixtures.title: physical departure is gated on a legal FIRST STEP and a positive return reserve, never on a known full route
fixtures.note: fullRouteKnown is false on every row, which is the expected and required state for frontier exploration.

fixtures.title: the suppression window outlives the party, so cooldown and concurrency are separately classified
fixtures.note: This is the measurement that makes the §4.1 rename a correction rather than a relabelling.

fixtures.title: a full expedition slot is classified ACTIVE_CAP_FULL
a returned exploration record changes one real physical action
fixtures.note: §13 requires this fixture to demonstrate the change or fail explicitly as a missing-reader finding. The positive control is what makes the failure evidence rather than an inert instrument.

fixtures.title: returned records are followed through the real annual compression authority
fixtures.note: Eviction is read from memoryCompression's own retained set, not inferred from a later known-tile count.

fixtures.title: a lost party transfers nothing
fixtures.note: No party is lost naturally on these worlds, so loss is forced through CORRECTION-17's existing frontierExplorationAlwaysLost option. Two independent assertions: no journey row reports a transfer, and the canonical writer produced no record at all on that arm.

fixtures.title: offer state is consumed exactly once per recorded opportunity, with nothing left over
fixtures.note: The last number is not a leak: the scheduler exits before both markers when the cap is full, the day is off cadence or too few workers are departable, so nothing is written and nothing is consumed.

fixtures.title: the O2 fallthrough-repair arm converts wasted decisions into launches and nothing else
fixtures.note: O2 only reconsiders a proposal the band had already derived, on a slot the claiming family left free.

fixtures.title: canonical state is identical with the funnel recording on and off
